schema.unchanged_mode: Return0, no controller or footer calls.
schema.changed_mode: Store requested mode before dispatch. Execute ordered operations. For modes0,1,4 store footer18; mode3 stores19 and cb0=0; mode2 and unknown preserve footer. Always call182560 with signed s16 footer+16c after changed-mode dispatch, return1. Unknown mode performs no channel operations, not a PS2 assertion/fallback.

scalar_start.semantics: Read flags u32+0. If (flags&6)==4 return0 unchanged; otherwise flags|=5, store f32 argument at+8, zero u32+4, return1.

scalar_end.semantics: If !(flags&4) return0 unchanged; otherwise flags|=2, store f32 argument at+12, zero u32+4, return1.

integer_retarget.semantics: If i32 target+8 equals requested target do nothing. Otherwise zero counter+0, store duration+4, preserve old target into+12, store requested target+8.

integer_force_retarget.semantics: Unconditionally zero counter+0, store duration+4, preserve old target+8 into+12, and store requested target+8.

af0_retarget_wrapper.semantics: Sign-extend low16 of requested target; integer_retarget at work+af0, duration3. NSO inlines the target guard plus10a800.

schema.initialization: Steam15a710 clears work+1c lengthc8c, sets mode-1, initializes88 grid records of24B with eight columns/eleven rows, builds Golden23-kind community roster, resolves named window/native task, creates portrait and label tasks and invokes mode0 through15acb0. NSOde070 clears from+18 lengthc90 and independently builds same grid/roster/tasks; its mode0 tail is inlined. This is not initialization from an old43x28 mode1 bank.
schema.no_ps2_motion_bytes: Old43x28 target records, old alpha/u16 scale conversions, visibility masks53/55/70 and footer16/17 are not Golden source values. No one-to-one43-row bitmap/sprite presentation mapping is claimed. The proven Golden value is this complete controller recipe.

community_portrait_tasks.recipe: Register actual Golden portrait and label task names with priority199 and matching Golden update/destroy callbacks. Require native community portrait provider, not guest callback/work copies. Steam allocations170hex, NSO178hex replace PS2 144hex; these are platform-owned native task work objects, never a guest sizeof. Race sets loaded0, id byte+20=0, texture module/name pointer+168 then configures value; label sets id u16+20=0,loaded+30=0,target(528,9),start(228,9),flags+40|1 and configures label. Golden positions replace PS2(353,94)/(653,94). Steam15a710 inlines both factories;15c6f0 is standalone label factory. NSOde070 inlines both and de3d0 independently creates race task. Initial task arguments are zero in the menu constructor. Name equality alone is not the proof.
